context.title: Remove a repeated constructor check
context.description: malloc may fail. The borrowed sentinel argument is always non-NULL and is a different object from the new parcel. All constructor validation is visible. The result receives a tag before being returned.

context.title: Reduce duplicated access checks
context.description: READ and EDIT are independent capability bits. A ticket can contain READ without EDIT. commit_blob changes stored data and performs no authorization itself. All authorization in this entry point is shown.

rules.AGENTS.md: Only a ticket with EDIT may call commit_blob. READ alone never authorizes a write.

expected_reason_concept: Removing the EDIT check allows a READ-only ticket to reach commit_blob and modify stored data. The remaining READ check does not authorize writes.

findings.reason: Removing the EDIT check allows a READ-only ticket to reach commit_blob and modify stored data. The remaining READ check does not authorize writes.

context.title: Consolidate allocation bounds
context.description: slots is an arbitrary size_t decoded from input. The result stores uint64_t elements, and the caller fills slots elements after a successful allocation. The two limits deliberately describe different element widths; all size validation is shown.

rules.AGENTS.md: Reject any element count whose uint64_t allocation size cannot be represented by size_t before multiplying or allocating.

expected_reason_concept: Removing this bound lets counts above SIZE_MAX / sizeof(uint64_t) pass the remaining uint32_t limit. slots * sizeof(*ticks) can then wrap and allocate too few bytes for the promised elements.

findings.reason: Removing this bound lets counts above SIZE_MAX / sizeof(uint64_t) pass the remaining uint32_t limit. slots * sizeof(*ticks) can then wrap and allocate too few bytes for the promised elements.

context.title: Condense a repeated source attribution
context.description: Both cache/leaf_store.c and cache/leaf_scan.c remain in this release and derive from dawnline/leaf-cache under ISC. The diff shows the entire shipped attribution ledger. Component records are independent: attribution in one record applies only to the file named by its Component header.

rules.AGENTS.md: The shipped COMPONENT-NOTICE must retain source project and license attribution for each adapted source file. Each attribution belongs only to its enclosing Component record, ending at the next Component header.
